summary.text: Mark Romanchuk is serving his second term in the Ohio Senate for District 22, which includes Ashland, Medina, and Richland counties. He previously served four terms in the Ohio House and chairs the Senate Medicaid Committee.

paragraphs.text: Romanchuk has over 35 years of experience in small business, systems engineering, management, and community development, and is owner and CEO of PR Machine Works, Inc., a contract manufacturer in Ontario.

Earlier he worked at Hughes Aircraft Company in a diplomatic capacity to the former Soviet Union in support of the Intermediate Range Nuclear Forces (INF) Treaty, and was based in Japan as a team leader and technical advisor to the U.S. Navy.
He is co-founder and past president of the Regional Manufacturing Coalition and past chairman of the Richland Area Chamber of Commerce Board of Directors, and serves on the Ashbrook Center Board.
